name: audience-aware-skills
description: Audience-aware agent communication. Bundles the know-your-audience skill: interview a scientist about one audience and add a register for it to their personal communication skill.

interface.shortDescription: Adapt agent communication to each reader
interface.longDescription: Interview a scientist about a real audience, then maintain one personal communication skill with universal preferences and an editable register for each reader.
defaultPrompt: Help me define how an agent should communicate with one of my audiences.
